'''Ryan William Downey''' is an American actor who works on the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Downey was born on May 2, 1984 in Elyria, Ohio. He received a Bachelor of Arts in Theatre Studies from Kent State University, where he studied to become a playwright. Upon graduating from college, Downey became a playwright, actor, musician, and producer. He started voicing characters for {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, becoming best known for his roles as [[Ippei]] and {{an|Hoopa}} in its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Hoopa|Hoopa Unbound}} form in ''[[M18|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages]]''. He currently resides in New York City, New York.
